'''Neesh''' was a [[Rodian]] [[bounty hunter]]. When assigned to assassinate a bumbling bounty hunter named [[Greedo]], he hired [[Spruch Goa|Spruch "Warhog" Goa]] to carry out the deed. Goa then encouraged Greedo to try and capture [[Han Solo]] on his own.<ref name="SWFC" />
